program:
PARAMS = {
    "W_in":  (80.0, 40.0, 160.0),   # diff pair W (L=1): low Vgs for tail headroom, low flicker noise
    "W_ld":  (30.0, 15.0, 60.0),    # PMOS mirror load W (L=0.5): wide to reduce Vsg
    "k_tail": (8.0, 6.0, 12.0),     # tail current / Iref
    "k_out": (40.0, 30.0, 60.0),    # 2nd-stage current / Iref
    "Cc":    (3.0e-12, 2.0e-12, 4.5e-12),
    "Rz":    (450.0, 200.0, 1200.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl, iref = spec["cl"], spec["iref"]
    Ln_b, Wn_ref = 1.0, 10.0          # wide NMOS bias -> low Vdsat for the tail source
    Lpair = 1.0
    Lp = 0.5
    kt, ko = p["k_tail"], p["k_out"]
    Itail = kt * iref
    I7 = ko * iref
    Wtail = Wn_ref * kt
    W8 = Wn_ref * ko
    Wld = p["W_ld"]
    W7 = Wld * (I7 / (Itail / 2.0))   # same current density as M3/M4 -> no systematic offset

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn_ref, Ln_b)
    n.M("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wtail, Ln_b)
    # diode side driven by the inverting terminal, mirror-output side by the non-inverting one
    n.M("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], Lpair)
    n.M("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], Lpair)
    n.M("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wld, Lp)
    n.M("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wld, Lp)
    n.M("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W7, Lp)
    n.M("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W8, Ln_b)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", p["Rz"])
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", p["Cc"])

    gmid1 = 20.0
    gm1 = gmid1 * Itail / 2.0
    gm7 = 11.0 * I7
    gds2 = gm1 / 120.0
    gds4 = (Itail / 2.0) * 9.0 / 84.0
    gds7 = gm7 / 84.0
    gds8 = I7 * 12.0 / 124.0
    A0 = (gm1 / (gds2 + gds4)) * (gm7 / (gds7 + gds8))
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * p["Cc"])
    C1 = 8.5e-15 * W7 * Lp * 0.67 + 0.2e-12
    p2 = gm7 * p["Cc"] / (C1 * cl + p["Cc"] * (C1 + cl)) / (2 * PI)
    pm = 90.0 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2)) + 5.0
    sr = min(Itail / p["Cc"], I7 / (cl + p["Cc"]))
    power = 1.8 * (iref + Itail + I7)
    preds = {
        "gain_db": 20 * math.log10(A0),
        "ugbw": gbw,
        "pm": pm,
        "power": power,
        "swing": 1.8 - 0.3 - 0.15,
        "slew": sr,
        "settle": 0.5 / sr + 4.6 / (2 * PI * gbw),
        "cmrr_db": 60.0,
        "psrr_db": 50.0,
        "noise_1k": 120e-9,
    }
    return n, preds
